target_claim: That $N \cap F = \O$ follows from the hypotheses actually stated (distributive lattice $L$, filter $F$, ideal $M$ disjoint from $F$ and maximal among ideals disjoint from $F$, $N = \set{x : \exists m \in M: x \le m \vee a}$, with $a$ an arbitrary element of $L$). The proof closes only by invoking the extra, unstated assumption "$\forall m \in M: m \vee a \notin F$"; without that assumption the conclusion is false, and a two-element lattice witnesses the failure.
source_quote: But this [[Definition:Contradiction|contradicts]] our assumption that $\forall m \in M: m \vee a \notin F$.
